dedupe_keys.name: connectivity performance metrics from grdc grain automate farms monthly by region 2024 to 2026 connected farms

description: A monthly series of farm network measurements from the Grain Automate project, which the records describe as peer-to-peer learning through the development of autonomous working farms. Each Zenodo record holds one month for one GRDC region (Northern, Southern or Western), with data usage, location mapping, uptime and downtime, wide area network quality and latency captured per device at each of three participating farms. DataCite lists about 73 distinct monthly titles and 147 DOIs, running from May 2024 to February 2026, created by Susan Maddalena and Connected Farms Pty. Ltd. Access to the files is restricted, so they must be requested through Zenodo; no licence or format is shown on the records read. Coverage is three farms in each of three Australian grain regions (nine farms), month by month. Caveats: farm names and locations are not public, device counts are not stated, and the files have not been seen. For simulation it gives real uptime, outage and latency data for rural farm networks that carry autonomous machinery, to model how telecom failures cascade into farm operations and to size backup links. A related catalogue record is the COMMECT radio KPI measurements of cellular and satellite links for rural livestock transport.
